Name: (CP) Ghostly Mariner Sprites
Author: SchrodingersKit
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=4]Updated for 1.6![/size][i]

"It's rumored that on stormy days, the ghost of an old mariner appears in Stardew Valley, clutching just such a pendant..."[/i]

Since the Old Mariner is a ghost, I recolored him into other ethereal palettes in the game~ One shares Grandpa's bright blues, and one shares the grayish green colors of the Ghost in the mines. Choose whichever version you prefer!

--

[size=2][b]To install Content Patcher version--[/b][/size]
1. Install the latest versions of [url=https://canimod.com/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
2. Unzip and paste into your 'Mods' folder.
3. After first run, go into the generated config.json (can be opened using [url=https://notepad-plus-plus.org/]Notepad++[/url] or program of your choice) to choose your desired color (default is Blue). Alternatively, use [url=http://https//www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to make your choice in-game.﻿
4. Load up your game and enjoy!

[b]To install XNB version--
1. Backup your original files![/b]
[b]2. [/b]Unzip the file with your program of choice
[b]3. [/b]Copy and paste the XNB file into its corresponding folder (Content > Characters)
[b]4. [/b]Load up your game and enjoy![/font]

Downloads.Description: Choose the color of Mariner Ghost you want with the config.json, generated on the first run after install. Works in Stardew 1.6. Requires the latest versions of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
